summary: Flat kerb on a quiet cul-de-sac bend, homes about 16 m away.
reasons: Dwellings 16-17 m away on this side
Quiet residential street, cars parked nearby

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings sit 16 m and 17 m from the kerb here, with non-dwelling buildings 11-12 m away; homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, cars park along this kerb, room to pull in.
drivers.traffic: Quiet cul-de-sac with little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Residents park on the street, no sign of overnight campers.

flags: Steeper past 90 m: up to about 19% max grade
sun_shade: Mostly open, some tree shade from the west side; morning sun from the east.

best_section.where: South side of the bend, beside the tennis court and pool houses
